title: The Deactivate window counts a customer once when a rep holds two fields
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin at the test location.
  • Create an active staff member for this test at the test location with the "Sales Representative" switch on: sales rep B.
  • Use a customer with "Sales Representative - Service Labor" and "Sales Representative - Service Parts" both set to sales rep B. No other customer has sales rep B.
  • Open Settings > Staff in a desktop browser at least 1024 pixels wide.
custom_steps:
1. Start deactivating sales rep B's account and read the Deactivate window.
  2. Cancel the deactivation.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Deactivate window reads "They will be removed as sales representative from 1 customer." ("customer", not "customers"; the customer is counted once).

Step 2:

  • Nothing changes.
  • Sales rep B stays active.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Splitting Sales Representatives", Confluence 919928833, version 11 (21 Oct 2026, Chris Ward), read 22 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-10890, story SV-11268 (Story 4, Give a customer default representatives)

  • S4-R21: “The Deactivate window, shown before deactivating a sales representative's account, counts every customer where they are in the first field, Service Parts or Part Sales, counting each customer once, and reads "They will be removed as sales representative from {n} customer{s}.", with "customer" when {n} is 1 and "customers" otherwise, in place of today's "Their customer assignments will stay where they are." The "Turn Off Sales Representative" warning, shown when the Sales Representative switch is turned off, does not change and shows no count (S4-N2).”

From: Chris Ward's answers to the Splitting Sales Representatives question sheet (answers 1 to 38, 19 Oct 2026; answers 39 and 40, 21 Oct 2026), read 22 Oct 2026

  • Chris Ward's answer 13: “13. (a) Only the Deactivate window; the Turn Off Sales Representative warning stays as it is.”
